_comment: MCP servers for INTERACTIVE work in Claude Code: auditioning voices,
spot-checking an image prompt, inspecting the repo from a chat session.
The nightly pipeline deliberately does NOT go through MCP. MCP needs an
MCP client (a model, in a session) in the loop for every call; a cron job
at 4am has no such session and should not need one. The pipeline stages
call the same vendor REST APIs directly, which also gives them retries,
per-beat resume, and cost accounting that an MCP round-trip would hide.
Both paths read the same .env, so a voice you audition here is the voice
